- RXDATA read has side effect: pops FIFO
- IRQ_STAT write has side effect: clears bits (RW1C)

# =============================================================================
# AXI UART Peripheral - RTL Lint Script
# =============================================================================
# Responsibility: Run SystemVerilog lint checks on RTL sources
# Tools Supported: Verilator, SystemVerlint
# Trace: REQ-LINT-001 (enforce coding standards before synthesis)
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
LINT_TOOL="verilator"
RTL_SOURCES=()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Usage Information
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
usage() {
    echo "Usage: $0 <source_files...> --tool <verilator|systemverlint>"
    echo "  source_files: List of SystemVerilog source files to lint"
    echo "  --tool: Lint tool to use (default: verilator)"
    echo ""
    echo "Example:"
    echo "  $0 rtl/pkg/uart_pkg.sv rtl/modules/*.sv rtl/axi_uart_top.sv --tool verilator"
    exit 1
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Argument Parsing
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        --tool)
            LINT_TOOL="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        --help|-h)
            usage
            ;;
        -*)
            echo "[ERROR] Unknown option: $1"
            usage
            ;;
        *)
            RTL_SOURCES+=("$1")
            shift
            ;;
    esac
done

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Input Validation
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ ${#RTL_SOURCES[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "[ERROR] No source files provided"
    usage
fi

if [[ "$LINT_TOOL" != "verilator" && "$LINT_TOOL" != "systemverlint" ]]; then
    echo "[ERROR] Unsupported lint tool: $LINT_TOOL"
    echo "Supported tools: verilator, systemverlint"
    exit 1
fi

# Validate all source files exist
for src in "${RTL_SOURCES[@]}"; do
    if [[ ! -f "$src" ]]; then
        echo "[ERROR] Source file not found: $src"
        exit 1
    fi
done

echo "[LINT] Linting ${#RTL_SOURCES[@]} source files with $LINT_TOOL..."

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lint Execution
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
case "$LINT_TOOL" in
    verilator)
        # Check if verilator is installed
        if ! command -v verilator &> /dev/null; then
            echo "[ERROR] verilator not found in PATH"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Run Verilator lint-only mode
        # --lint-only: skip compilation, only check syntax/style
        # -Wall: enable all warnings
        # --Wno-fatal: continue on warnings (for reporting purposes)
        verilator --lint-only -Wall --Wno-fatal \
            --top-module axi_uart_top \
            "${RTL_SOURCES[@]}"
        ;;
    
    systemverlint)
        # Check if systemverlint is installed
        if ! command -v systemverlint &> /dev/null; then
            echo "[ERROR] systemverlint not found in PATH"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Run SystemVerlint on all sources
        # Config file (.systemverlint) can be used for project-specific rules
        systemverlint "${RTL_SOURCES[@]}"
        ;;
esac

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Result Reporting
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
LINT_STATUS=$?

if [[ $LINT_STATUS -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "[LINT] All lint checks passed"
    exit 0
else
    echo "[LINT] Lint checks failed with status $LINT_STATUS"
    echo "[LINT] Please fix the reported issues before proceeding"
    exit $LINT_STATUS
fi

# AXI UART Peripheral - RTL Lint Script
# =============================================================================
# Responsibility: Run SystemVerilog lint checks on RTL sources
# Tools Supported: Verilator, SystemVerlint
# Trace: REQ-LINT-001 (enforce coding standards before synthesis)
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
LINT_TOOL="verilator"
RTL_SOURCES=()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Usage Information
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
usage() {
    echo "Usage: $0 <source_files...> --tool <verilator|systemverlint>"
    echo "  source_files: List of SystemVerilog source files to lint"
    echo "  --tool: Lint tool to use (default: verilator)"
    echo ""
    echo "Example:"
    echo "  $0 rtl/pkg/uart_pkg.sv rtl/modules/*.sv rtl/axi_uart_top.sv --tool verilator"
    exit 1
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Argument Parsing
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        --tool)
            LINT_TOOL="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        --help|-h)
            usage
            ;;
        -*)
            echo "[ERROR] Unknown option: $1"
            usage
            ;;
        *)
            RTL_SOURCES+=("$1")
            shift
            ;;
    esac
done

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Input Validation
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ ${#RTL_SOURCES[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "[ERROR] No source files provided"
    usage
fi

if [[ "$LINT_TOOL" != "verilator" && "$LINT_TOOL" != "systemverlint" ]]; then
    echo "[ERROR] Unsupported lint tool: $LINT_TOOL"
    echo "Supported tools: verilator, systemverlint"
    exit 1
fi

# Validate all source files exist
for src in "${RTL_SOURCES[@]}"; do
    if [[ ! -f "$src" ]]; then
        echo "[ERROR] Source file not found: $src"
        exit 1
    fi
done

echo "[LINT] Linting ${#RTL_SOURCES[@]} source files with $LINT_TOOL..."

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lint Execution
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
case "$LINT_TOOL" in
    verilator)
        # Check if verilator is installed
        if ! command -v verilator &> /dev/null; then
            echo "[ERROR] verilator not found in PATH"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Run Verilator lint-only mode
        # --lint-only: skip compilation, only check syntax/style
        # -Wall: enable all warnings
        # --Wno-fatal: continue on warnings (for reporting purposes)
        verilator --lint-only -Wall --Wno-fatal \
            --top-module axi_uart_top \
            "${RTL_SOURCES[@]}"
        ;;
    
    systemverlint)
        # Check if systemverlint is installed
        if ! command -v systemverlint &> /dev/null; then
            echo "[ERROR] systemverlint not found in PATH"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Run SystemVerlint on all sources
        # Config file (.systemverlint) can be used for project-specific rules
        systemverlint "${RTL_SOURCES[@]}"
        ;;
esac

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Result Reporting
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
LINT_STATUS=$?

if [[ $LINT_STATUS -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "[LINT] All lint checks passed"
    exit 0
else
    echo "[LINT] Lint checks failed with status $LINT_STATUS"
    echo "[LINT] Please fix the reported issues before proceeding"
    exit $LINT_STATUS
fi

- AXI-Lite slave interface: awaddr/awvalid/awready, wdata/wstrb/wvalid/wready, bresp/bvalid/bready, araddr/arvalid/arready, rdata/rresp/rvalid/rready

- Interrupt output: irq (level-sensitive)
- Error status inputs: framing_err, rx_overrun

- Reset release is synchronous to clk

**Write Path (REQ-002, TEST-011):**
- TXDATA write: if !tx_full, enqueue byte (tx_fifo_push=1) and return OKAY; if tx_full, return SLVERR
- CTRL write: update control register fields (TX_EN, RX_EN, PARITY_EN, INT_EN)
- BAUD write: update baud_div[15:0], new rate takes effect on subsequent frames (REQ-005)
- IRQ_STAT write: RW1C semantics - writing 1 clears corresponding interrupt status bit
- Invalid address writes return SLVERR

**Read Path (TEST-020):**
- CTRL read: return current control register value
- STATUS read: return tx_empty, tx_full, rx_empty, rx_full, framing_err, rx_overrun, int_pending
- RXDATA read: return oldest byte from RX FIFO and pop (rx_fifo_pop=1)
- BAUD read: return current baud_div value
- Invalid address reads return SLVERR

  - (ctrl_tx_irq_en && tx_empty) OR

- SVA property: (ctrl_rx_irq_en && !rx_empty) |-> irq

- RXDATA read has side effect: pops FIFO
- IRQ_STAT write has side effect: clears bits (RW1C)
- TXDATA write has side effect: pushes to TX FIFO (if not full)
